purpose: canonical Edge/Office execution hosts for local render and content capabilities

routing.healthRule: host must be registered, online, repo-synced, pass its local bootstrap/doctor, and carry a verified render-smoke receipt before receiving render work
routing.subscriptionRule: browser subscription sessions stay on sderot-mac; never copy cookies or subscription credentials to fallback hosts
routing.qualityRule: host failover changes execution location only; it never relaxes Content Contract, Asset Truth, Claim Provenance, QA, receipt or publish gates

sderot-mac.verifiedEvidence: real local HyperFrames smoke render completed with ffprobe receipt and canonical Cursor worker running on Mac-Office on 2026-09-12
sderot-mac.promotionRule: backend live_verified only after host smoke + real approved asset render + existing QA + failover verification

sderot-windows.promotionRule: becomes host_smoke_verified and eligible for first-healthy fallback only after Remote Desktop Commander reports the physical Windows device online and the local bootstrap records doctor=pass plus renderSmoke=pass with a real receipt; no browser-subscription credential migration
